figurative_meaning_en: extremely obedient; subservient; under complete control
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার স্ত্রীর লেজধরা হয়ে গেছে।
অফিসের বসের লেজধরা করতে হলে সফল হওয়া কঠিন।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become his wife's tail-holder.
It's hard to succeed if you have to be the boss's tail-holder at the office.
note: The idiom draws from the image of a dog being led by its tail, emphasizing total submission.
